coverage: Whole group totals · no reportable business segments
incomeDefinition: Interest income, fees and commission, fair-value gains, income on loans sold on (assigned) and other income. It is gross income before interest paid on borrowings, loan-loss provisions and other costs; it is not sales.
definition: Consolidated profit after tax, after exceptional items and tax, less the share that belongs to minority (non-controlling) shareholders of group subsidiaries. It is not operating profit or cash flow.
location: Annual report 2025–26, consolidated statement of profit and loss: PDF pages 15–16, printed pages 380–381; note 37 (exceptional items) PDF page 68, printed page 433; note 39 (no separate operating segments)
notes: Interest income is ₹72,776.01 crore of the ₹81,989.50 crore total income (revenue from operations ₹81,982.38 crore plus other income ₹7.12 crore). Profit after tax before minority shareholders is ₹19,332.36 crore; minority shareholders’ share is ₹314.97 crore, leaving ₹19,017.39 crore for owners. Profit is after an exceptional charge of ₹265.22 crore for the increase in past-service gratuity cost from the new Labour Codes (note 37) and after a tax expense of ₹6,484.29 crore. The group reports no separate operating segments, so profit is not disclosed for any loan product.
insight: Most of the group’s income is interest charged on loans, and a large part goes to pay for borrowed money and for loans that may not be repaid. These totals cannot show which loan product earns the most.
